name: ClearPoint Neuro, Inc.
summary: ClearPoint Neuro, Inc., a commercial-stage medical device company, focuses on the development and commercialization of platforms for performing minimally invasive surgical procedures in the brain in the United States. The company offers ClearPoint systems, such as ClearPoint hardware, which includes head fixation frame, computer workstation, and in-room monitor; and ClearPoint disposables, which consist of SmartFrame trajectory device, a hand controller and related accessories, and its SmartFlow Neuro cannula.
